description: First-time setup, the owner's only: record the user's interview answers as bootstrap/IDENTITY.md, bootstrap/CHARACTER.md and bootstrap/USER.md and as an identity-layer entry, and create the owner person. Every write is read-back verified. Refused under a bot tag. On a store that is already set up it is refused unless reissue is true (the owner's explicit word): a re-run writes new versions of the user's identity documents; prior versions are archived, never destroyed. answers.more_than_one_bot is optional. Absent or no leaves sub-keys off. yes writes EMET_SUBKEYS=1, a generated pepper and EMET_SUBKEY_PEPPER_VERSION=1 into .env only when that file is the config source, after the store writes succeed, and does not turn the flag on in this process. A hosted server refuses yes and returns the three variables to set, then redeploy. See docs/SUBKEYS.md. answers.bot_team_backup is optional. Yes or no, in the user's words, the same way as more_than_one_bot. Yes and Yes. record the flag. yes is the recommended choice. Absent or no leaves bot-team backup off. Anything else, including a non-string, is refused before a write. Setup does not copy prompts or settings.

answers.description: Answers keyed exactly as the interview questions returned by emet_initialize.

bot_team_backup.description: Optional. Yes or no, in the user's words. Yes and Yes. count as yes. yes is the recommended choice and records bot-team backup as on. Absent or no leaves it off. A non-string is refused. Do not invent this answer.

more_than_one_bot.description: Optional. yes or no, in the user's words. Absent or no leaves sub-keys off. yes turns them on only when this server reads .env. Do not invent this answer.

reissue.description: Only on the owner's explicit word: re-run setup on a store that is already set up. Without it, a re-run is refused and nothing is written.

source.description: Your source tag. Setup is refused under a bot tag.

name: emet_setup_complete
